description: Download AlphaFold CACUL1 model via API and profile pLDDT
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
j=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q86Y37', timeout=120).json()
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in j[0].items() if 'Url' in k or k in ('entryId','uniprotStart','uniprotEnd','latestVersion','modelCreatedDate')}, indent=1))
url=j[0]['pdbUrl']
r=requests.get(url, timeout=120); print(r.status_code, len(r.text))
open('AF-Q86Y37-model.pdb','w').write(r.text)
plddt={}
for line in r.text.split('\n'):
    if line.startswith('ATOM') and line[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        plddt[int(line[22:26])]=float(line[60:66])
s=pd.Series(plddt).sort_index()
print('n res',len(s),'mean pLDDT',round(s.mean(),1))
regions={'N-term 1-130 (outside Pfam)':(1,130),'Pfam PF00888 137-293':(137,293),'C-term 294-369':(294,369)}
for k,(a,b) in regions.items():
    sub=s.loc[(s.index>=a)&(s.index<=b)]
    print(f'  {k}: mean pLDDT {sub.mean():.1f}  frac>70 {100*(sub>70).mean():.0f}%  frac<50 {100*(sub<50).mean():.0f}%')
s.to_csv('cacul1_plddt_per_residue.csv', header=['pLDDT'])
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3.2))
ax.plot(s.index,s.values,lw=1.2,color='#2b6cb0')
for lo,hi,c in [(0,50,'#f56565'),(50,70,'#ed8936'),(70,90,'#48bb78'),(90,100,'#2f855a')]:
    ax.axhspan(lo,hi,color=c,alpha=0.12)
ax.axvspan(137,293,color='#4299e1',alpha=0.18)
ax.text(215,8,'Pfam PF00888 cullin repeat (137-293)',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('CACUL1 residue (Q86Y37)'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title('AlphaFold confidence across CACUL1')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
